channel.title: Tech Kadak — naye free apps
channel.description: Paid app ka FREE jawab — roz naye free apps, AI tools & GitHub gems, simple Hinglish mein.

item.title: Catima
item.description: Saare loyalty cards, membership cards aur coupons ek app mein — camera se barcode scan karo, plastic cards ghar pe chhodo. No internet access, no ads.

item.title: Binary Eye
item.description: Fast QR + barcode scanner jo QR bhi bana sakta hai. No ads, open-source.

item.title: Fossify File Manager
item.description: Fast, ad-free file manager: search, compress, favourite folders, hidden files pe password/fingerprint lock. Internet access hi nahi.

item.title: Fossify Calendar
item.description: Clean, ad-free calendar: events, reminders, repeat rules, widgets. Google Calendar/Outlook ke saath sync bhi.

item.title: Tasks.org
item.description: To-do list jo offline chale: nested subtasks, repeating tasks, tags, reminders. Google Tasks sync optional.

item.title: VLC
item.description: Lagbhag har video aur audio format chala deta hai — phone ki files bhi, network streams bhi. Fast, no ads.

item.title: Image Toolbox
item.description: Photo ka swiss knife: resize, crop, compress, format convert, filters, OCR (text nikalna), background remove, EXIF edit, PDF banana.

item.title: ColorBlendr
item.description: Android 12+ pe Material You / system accent colors customize: wallpaper ya apna seed color, saturation/lightness sliders, presets, pitch black.

item.title: URLCheck
item.description: Link kholne se pehle beech me khulta hai: redirects/short links check, URL details, trackers hatana, suspicious/phishing links pe warning (VirusTotal, hosts list).

item.title: HTTP Shortcuts
item.description: Custom HTTP requests (APIs, webhooks, smart home, automation) ko home screen shortcut bana do; ek tap me request chalti hai. Scripting + variables bhi.

item.title: OpenScan
item.description: Privacy wala document scanner: documents/notes/cards scan, live edge detection se auto crop, filters, PDF/JPG export. No ads.

item.title: LanguageTool
item.description: Assignment, email, resume ki English grammar + spelling galtiyan pakdo. Chrome, Word, Google Docs mein chalta hai.

item.title: Khan Academy
item.description: Class 1-12 Maths, Science aur aur subjects: videos, practice, tests. NCERT/CBSE aligned, Hindi mein bhi. Nonprofit.

item.title: NPTEL
item.description: IIT aur IISc ke courses — padhai bilkul free, koi bhi join kar sakta hai.

item.title: Obsidian
item.description: Unlimited notes, bina sign-up, offline. Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux sab pe.

item.title: Zotero
item.description: Research papers, PDFs save karo, ek click mein citation/bibliography. Project aur thesis ke liye best. Open-source, nonprofit.

item.title: AnySoftKeyboard
item.description: Open-source keyboard: layouts, themes, gesture typing — sab apni marzi ka.

item.title: Quillpad
item.description: Markdown notes, task lists, notebooks, tags, reminders — no ads.

item.title: APKUpdater
item.description: Installed apps ke updates kai sources (F-Droid, GitHub, Play, APKMirror...) se ek jagah check karta hai, background notification ke saath.

item.title: GKD
item.description: Accessibility + custom rules se repetitive screen taps automate karo (advanced users ke liye).

item.title: SD Maid SE
item.description: Storage analyse karo, cache aur uninstalled apps ki leftover files clean karo, duplicates dhoondo.

item.title: Rethink: DNS + Firewall + VPN
item.description: Apps ki network activity dikhata hai, per-app firewall (internet block), DNS blocklists se ads/trackers block.

item.title: App Manager
item.description: Apps ki activities, permissions, signatures dekho; apps me trackers/libraries scan karo.

item.title: Kvaesitso Launcher
item.description: Search-focused launcher: apps, contacts, calendar, Wikipedia ek search me; calculator + unit converter.

item.title: Arcticons
item.description: 15,000+ line-style icons — minimal, clutter-free home screen.

item.title: Discreet Launcher
item.description: Distraction-free home screen, apps rename/hide, offline, no ads, icon packs support.

item.title: Spliit
item.description: Trip, hostel, flat ka kharcha split karo — no ads, no account, open-source (Splitwise Pro ka free jawab).

item.title: Wormhole
item.description: 10 GB tak file bhejo bina signup, end-to-end encrypted (WeTransfer ka free jawab).

item.title: Proton VPN Free
item.description: Free VPN: no ads, no logs, data/speed ki koi limit nahi (NordVPN ka free jawab).

item.title: Bitwarden
item.description: Password manager: unlimited passwords, unlimited devices, open-source (1Password ka free jawab).
